architecture_authority.decision: Architecture is normative; the construction plan is its executable projection.

checks.name: single_release_ledger
checks.evidence: ReleaseControl is the only A0-A10 selector and owns the sole release state and lock.

checks.name: legacy_queues_historical
checks.evidence: R, DDO, and CPL snapshots remain preserved with HISTORICAL_READ_ONLY disposition and grant no v2.1 completion.

checks.name: legacy_controllers_superseded
checks.evidence: Legacy next, claim, complete, and invalidate paths fail closed when the sole ReleaseLedger exists; read-only audit/status and stale-lock cleanup remain possible.

checks.name: one_lock_one_next_task
checks.evidence: The release audit returned one eligible A0 task, and claim created one matching lock and state transition.

checks.name: task_path_ownership_disjoint
checks.evidence: All A0-A10 allowed path patterns are pairwise disjoint; numbered Evidence globs use an underscore delimiter.

checks.name: phase_status_progression
checks.evidence: Pending states are derived from the next task phase, including A7 architecture migration, A8 text shadow, A9 holdout, and A10 media.

checks.name: bounded_control_output
checks.evidence: Claim CLI returned six summary fields while the complete manifest remained only in the lock.

checks.name: architecture_bundle_locked
checks.evidence: Every loaded A task locks both the unchanged v2.0 base hash and the v2.1 normative amendment hash; state was updated only through rebase-architecture.

checks.name: manual_release_gates
checks.evidence: A10 completion requires separately recorded media and owner Evidence with live hashes; owner approval binds the current media hash and cannot authorize production.

checks.name: construction_entry_migrated
checks.evidence: Root guidance, README, construction protocol, and /mode-p-vnext-rebuild all select release_control and the v2.1 authority bundle.

checks.name: production_v4_unchanged
checks.evidence: A10 checks production_entry before completion; A0 leaves all external, media, owner, and production gates false.
